E-mail notice after a password change

To get an e-mail after you change your password, set up the free EmailJS service once (about 5 minutes):

1. Create an account at emailjs.com.

2. Email Services > Add New Service > Gmail > Connect. Copy its Service ID.

3. Email Templates > Create New Template. Set To Email to {{to_email}}, Subject to "Your LOCUS password was changed", and put {{message}} and {{time}} in the content. Save and copy the Template ID.

4. Account > General: copy your Public Key.

5. Account > Security: turn ON "Allow EmailJS API for non-browser applications".

6. Paste the three values below, tap Save, then tap Send test e-mail.
Fill in the Service ID, Template ID and Public Key first.

1. Open the Firebase console, create a project (free) and add an Android app with the package name com.locus.app.

2. Build > Authentication > Get started > turn on Email/Password.

3. Build > Firestore Database > Create database. Then open Rules, paste the file firestore.rules from the project and Publish.

4. Project settings > your Android app > download google-services.json to this phone.

5. Tap the button below and choose that file. No rebuild is needed.

Posts reach other phones only through the cloud. One-time setup (about 10 minutes):

1. Create a Firebase project and add an Android app with the package name com.locus.app.
2. Put the downloaded google-services.json in the app folder and build the APK again.
3. Authentication: turn on Email/Password.
4. Firestore Database: create it, then open Rules, paste the file firestore.rules from the project and Publish.
5. Install that same APK on every phone and log in.

The README has the full steps.
